items.title: Welcome to ArcheaAge!
items.body:
Private ArcheAge server in beta phase, based on the AAEmu fork.

Flagship version: 1.2 (launch era) with the 1.2.4.0 client. Download the client from the launcher and join the EU-1 / NA-1 servers.

items.title: Client download status
items.body: The client (~8.3 GB) downloads in parts from Google Drive with resume support and SHA256 verification. If the download is interrupted there is no need to start over: hit "Download" again and it will continue.

items.title: Roadmap
items.body: Next milestones: pak merge (aapatcher), the 3.0 line, plugin SDK and anti-cheat. The detailed roadmap lives in docs/SPEC.md of the repository.
